scripts.build: npm run gen && mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Isrc src/orbiter_kernel.cpp src/main.cpp -o build/orbiter_kernel
scripts.test: npm run build && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Isrc src/orbiter_kernel.cpp tests/kernel_test.cpp -o build/kernel_test && ./build/kernel_test
